mapper.insert: insert into common_system_settings (setting_key, setting_value, unit, updated_by, change_reason) values (#{settingKey}, #{settingValue}, #{unit}, #{updatedBy}, #{changeReason}) on conflict (setting_key) do update set setting_value = EXCLUDED.setting_value, unit = EXCLUDED.unit, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, change_reason = EXCLUDED.change_reason
